route_title: HfO2-MgF2 Fabry-Perot Cavity Bandpass Filter for Solar-Blind UV
compilation_rationale: Explicit 29-layer HfO2/MgF2 stack on SiO2 substrate compiled as a coherent TMM architecture. Quarter-wave initial thicknesses (~100 nm) assigned with 0.5×–1.5× optimization bounds. Coherent smatrix solver handles normal unpolarized incidence. Three band-specific transmittance targets enforce the requested pass and stop behaviors without altering physical observables or inventing results.
